author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Cartoon tree mirrored about x=24: scalloped cloud canopy (two big top bumps, small middle bump, side bumps, shallow bottom scallops), open trunk walls to the ground, an angular nose jutting left out of the trunk, eye dot and frown arc on the axis. No Lucide match; cubic bump construction with exact extremes.
omissions: The trunk is wider than in the reference and the nose is an angular wedge on the trunk wall instead of a separate crossing stroke; the second (vertical) eye mark is a dot. The face needs 8-unit spacing between the nose, eye, frown and trunk walls.
